COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJR No. 07 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
None is present for the revisionist/convict. 
2. Mr. S. S. Chauhan, learned D.A.G. assisted 
by Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for 
the State.
3. The present Criminal Jail Revision under 
Section 438 & 442 of BNSS has been filed by the 
Revisionist, Bhawan Singh S/o Shri Gulab Singh, 
who had been convicted under Section 409 of IPC, 
through Jailor, District Jail, Almora. 
4. This Court appoints Ms. Sheetal Selwal, 
Advocate as Amicus Curiae to assist the Court on 
behalf of the Revisionist.
5. List this matter on 01.12.2025.
6. Learned Amicus Curiae for the 
Revisionist/convict be informed accordingly. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
